name: agentmemory-capture
description: OpenCode plugin for agentmemory - 41 capture paths: 31 narrowed bus-event branches, 8 awaited hooks, the event dispatcher, and dispose. Captures session lifecycle, completed assistant text, prompts, tool results, diffs, permissions, tasks, commands, diagnostics, questions, MCP events, PTY events, and per-tool commit links. Injects session and file context, reopens resumed sessions, bounds payloads, and leaves corpus-wide maintenance to configured server schedules. Ships 16 skills and installs with `agentmemory connect opencode --with-plugin`.
